caption: The drawing depicts a circular composition centered on a basket filled with flowers and leaves. The background within the circle is a textured, solid red color, bordered by a rough gray outline that separates the red circle from the plain beige outer area. The basket is colored brown with visible weave details, and it holds multiple flowers and leaves. The flowers are primarily white to light gray in color, with some shading in darker grays for depth. The leaves are various shades of green with darker and lighter accents to indicate veins and dimension. The overall arrangement is dense, with the flowers and leaves overlapping and filling the center of the circular composition, while the basket and floral arrangement sit against the red backdrop.
title: Embroidered Footstool Cover
